title: Granularity from Bounded Fourier Degree
statement: Let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, and let $k\ge 1$ be an integer such that every nonzero Fourier coefficient of $f$ is indexed by a set of size at most $k$. Then each Fourier coefficient of $f$ is an integer multiple of $2^{1-k}$.
hypotheses_covered: The Fourier degree of $f$ is at most $k$
